rows.name: size
rows.description: The size of the Text Area element can be either "small" or "large".

rows.name: containerProps
rows.description: use this property to assign props to parent container of this component, for example, id or data attributes, etc

rows.name: supportMessageProps
rows.description: use this property to assign customized props to support message, such as data attributes

rows.name: labelText
rows.description: The label of the input field.

rows.name: showCounter
rows.description: Shows a counter in the bottom right if true. Can be clubbed with maxLength.

rows.name: inputText
rows.description: The controlled value of the textarea

rows.name: counterLimitMessage
rows.description: optional message that will read out loud by screen readers when the character limit is reached

rows.name: counterMilestone
rows.description: use this optional property to declare the number of characters required to trigger a specialised message to the screen reader users. When using along with maxLength this value should always be kept less than the maxLength.

rows.name: counterMilestoneMessage
rows.description: optional message that will read out loud by screen readers when the counterMilestone is reached.

rows.name: showHandle
rows.description: Can be used to show/hide the resize handle, leading to enabling/disabling the resizing of the component.

rows.name: readOnly
rows.type: A boolean that represents the element's readonly attribute, indicating that the user cannot modify the value of the control. | readonly

rows.name: disabled
rows.type: A boolean that represents the element's disabled attribute, indicating that the control is not available for interaction. The input values will not be submitted with the form. See also readonly. | disabled | readonly

rows.name: placeholder
rows.description: A string that represents the element's placeholder attribute, containing a hint to the user of what can be entered in the control. The placeholder text must not contain carriage returns or line-feeds.

rows.name: required
rows.type: A boolean that represents the element's required attribute, indicating that the user must fill in a value before submitting a form. | required

rows.name: maxLength
rows.type: A number that represents the element's maxlength attribute, containing the maximum number of characters (in Unicode code points) that the value can have. | maxlength
